ORIGINAL production asset sheet for secret-map interactions in a colorful post-apocalyptic mobile tower-defense game. Same playful casual-game cartoon style: chunky simplified shapes, clean dark outlines, saturated colors, soft cel shading, no realism, no text, no logos.

On a warm off-white background, create TWO coherent interactive secret props, each shown in multiple states with identical camera/proportions.

PROP 1 — MAINTENANCE TUNNEL:
- concealed/closed wall panel overgrown with vines,
- hinted state with faint green light from cracks,
- open state with short tunnel visible.

PROP 2 — RADIO RELAY NODE:
- dormant small overgrown relay mast/dish with dead lights,
- hinted state with one blinking amber indicator,
- activated state with rotating dish and bright teal salvage-energy pulse.

All states must be isolated with clear spacing, top-down/3/4 game camera, mobile-readable silhouettes. No roads, no characters, no readable symbols/letters/numbers, no UI. Original IP only.
